buildouts in history—and they rely on Marvell as a critical AI infrastructure partner. Marvell
designs custom silicon tailored for any application and offers the industry’s most comprehensive
portfolio of interconnects and network switch products. From custom compute to rack, row, data
center, campus and multi-campus connectivity, Marvell enables the world’s most advanced AI
infrastructure.

### Modernizing and Securing Networks

network that spans from HQ to branch to data center to cloud. Network equipment must support rising

world’s diverse connectivity needs for years to come. Marvell compute, security and networking
platforms effectively operate on a global scale with the performance and programmability that enable
carriers to sustainably innovate in this frontier without compromise.

## Marvell Enables AI Infrastructure

To realize the promise of AI, hyperscalers are undertaking one of the largest infrastructure
buildouts in history—and they rely on Marvell as a critical AI infrastructure partner. Marvell
designs custom silicon tailored for any application and offers the industry’s most comprehensive
portfolio of interconnects and network switch products. From custom compute to rack, row, data
center, campus and multi-campus connectivity, Marvell enables the world’s most advanced AI
infrastructure.

[Learn More][120]
[Play video]

* ENTERPRISE
* CARRIER

As the number and size of AI models explodes, data center infrastructure requirements are evolving
rapidly, forcing innovation across the compute, interconnect and switching domains of accelerated
infrastructure. Marvell custom silicon and system-level connectivity platforms enable hyperscalers
to design and implement their own unique AI data-center architectures optimized for their own unique
applications.

DATA CENTER

### Scaling AI

As the number and size of AI models explodes, data center infrastructure requirements are evolving
rapidly, forcing innovation across the compute, interconnect and switching domains of accelerated
infrastructure. Marvell custom silicon and system-level connectivity platforms enable hyperscalers
to design and implement their own unique AI data-center architectures optimized for their own unique
applications.

[Learn More][121]
Marvell Enterprise Solutions
[Marvell Enterprise Solutions]
ENTERPRISE

### Modernizing and Securing Networks

To power digital transformation, there must be a more robust, secure and autonomous enterprise
network that spans from HQ to branch to data center to cloud. Network equipment must support rising
bandwidth demands, a more complex threat landscape and the analytics needed to power AIOps tools.
Marvell has a networking and compute portfolio that delivers performance, intelligence, security and
telemetry needed for the modern enterprise network.

[Learn More][122]
Marvell 5G wireless carrier solutions
[Marvell 5G wireless carrier solutions]
CARRIER

### Connecting the World with 5G Network Silicon

With increased capabilities, performance and edge intelligence, 5G enables a plethora of new
consumer and enterprise applications that promise to transform entire industries and serve the
world’s diverse connectivity needs for years to come. Marvell compute, security and networking
platforms effectively operate on a global scale with the performance and programmability that enable
carriers to sustainably innovate in this frontier without compromise.

Antigravity 2.0

Your command center to manage multiple local agents in parallel. Group conversations into Projects,
operate across multiple workspaces, and automate routine tasks with scheduled messages.

[Your command center to manage multiple local agents in parallel. Group conversations into Projects,
operate across multiple workspaces, and automate routine tasks with scheduled messages.]
Antigravity CLI

The lightweight, fast, terminal-first surface to work with Antigravity agents. Run autonomous coding
agents, execute shell commands directly, and manage background subagents all from your keyboard.

[The lightweight, fast, terminal-first surface to work with Antigravity agents. Run autonomous
coding agents, execute shell commands directly, and manage background subagents all from your
keyboard.]
Antigravity SDK

Prototype custom agents leveraging Antigravity's harness with minimal code. Simple Python scripts to
iterate on agentic applications, automate software engineering tasks, and run evaluations on top of
the Antigravity agent harness.

[Prototype custom agents leveraging Antigravity's harness with minimal code. Simple Python scripts
to iterate on agentic applications, automate software engineering tasks, and run evaluations on top
of the Antigravity agent harness.]

The fully-featured, agentic IDE. Complete with the agent manager, artifacts, and a deep
understanding of your codebase.

[Shiny green car in front of a CARFAX report with a warning symbol.]

## We check every car for any reports of:
* Damage or accidents
* Maintenance and inspections
* Mileage manipulations
* Import information
* Thefts
* Change of ownership

* Taxi or rental car use

## How we help you find the best car

At CARFAX, we collect events from the lives of millions of used cars from 20 European countries, as
well as the USA and Canada. We can then create a vehicle history for every car in our database and
make it available to you. The information helps you to check sales data, avoid expensive follow-up
costs and negotiate a fair purchase price.

provider of Intelligent Transportation Systems for transit agencies around the world.

### Frank Antonysamy

#### Chief Executive Officer, Clever Devices

Frank Antonysamy joins Clever Devices as Chief Executive Officer, bringing over 25 years of global
leadership experience in digital services, industrial AI, and IoT-led business transformation. Most
recently serving as Chief Growth Officer at Hitachi Digital, he has been instrumental in driving
growth strategy, building strategic partnerships (including NVIDIA, Microsoft, and SingTel), and
leading the launch of Hitachi’s Industrial AI portfolio. Prior to this, Frank held senior executive
roles at Hitachi Vantara and Cognizant. As CEO, Frank will focus on accelerating growth,
strengthening market positioning, and driving long-term value creation, further advancing our
digital journey and HMAX growth.

### PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION IS ALL WE DO

We make it our business to understand yours. We know an off-the-shelf solution won’t help you
deliver the services your riders demand. Whether you have 50 vehicles or 5000, for over thirty years
public transportation providers like you have chosen Clever Devices to help them create efficiencies
and improve the customer experience.

### A Powerful New Chapter in Transit

## Hitachi Rail completes acquisition of Clever Devices

Hitachi Rail has successfully completed the acquisition of Clever Devices, a leading U.S.-based
provider of Intelligent Transportation Systems for transit agencies around the world.

[ Read the Press Release ][106]

### Bus

Tools that help you work smarter and safer, visibility to manage operations more efficiently and
communication solutions that increase passenger satisfaction

[Bus Solutions][107]

### Rail

Solutions that increase reliability, improve safety and give your passengers the information they
need to get where they need to go

[Rail Solutions][108]

### Paratransit

Streamline costs while delivering premium service to those who depend on your agency

[Paratransit Solutions][109]

### Frank Antonysamy

#### Chief Executive Officer, Clever Devices

Frank Antonysamy joins Clever Devices as Chief Executive Officer, bringing over 25 years of global
leadership experience in digital services, industrial AI, and IoT-led business transformation. Most
recently serving as Chief Growth Officer at Hitachi Digital, he has been instrumental in driving
growth strategy, building strategic partnerships (including NVIDIA, Microsoft, and SingTel), and
leading the launch of Hitachi’s Industrial AI portfolio. Prior to this, Frank held senior executive
roles at Hitachi Vantara and Cognizant. As CEO, Frank will focus on accelerating growth,
strengthening market positioning, and driving long-term value creation, further advancing our
digital journey and HMAX growth.

### PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION IS ALL WE DO

We make it our business to understand yours. We know an off-the-shelf solution won’t help you
deliver the services your riders demand. Whether you have 50 vehicles or 5000, for over thirty years
public transportation providers like you have chosen Clever Devices to help them create efficiencies
and improve the customer experience.

#### Operations Control

Our multi-modal fleet management solutions provide complete situational awareness & communications
capabilities for efficient management of resources.

[Learn More][110]

#### Safety and Security

Our safety and security solutions keep your operators, your riders and even your pedestrians on the
street.

[Learn More][111]

#### Business Intelligence

Our full suite of business intelligence tools provide the historical visibility needed to make the
changes that improve efficiency and optimize operations.

[Learn More ][112]

#### Planning and Scheduling

Our powerful planning and scheduling solutions simplify and optimize your processes to ensure that
you are creating reliable service in the most economical and efficient manner possible.

[Learn More ][113]

#### Yard and Asset Management

Unexpected mechanical breakdowns and poor depot management all contribute to unhappy riders. Our
solutions help you maintain your fleet and stay on schedule.

[Learn More ][114]

#### Real-Time Passenger Information

Accurate and reliable passenger information is critical to increasing mass transport ridership and
can have positive economic effects on a city by reducing lost productivity and personal time.

[Learn More ][115]

### SO MUCH RIDES ON THE TECHNOLOGY YOU CHOOSE

#### Over 30,000 vehicles run on Clever Devices ITS technology

From operations control to real-time passenger information. From safety and security to planning and
scheduling – our solutions power public transport providers of all sizes. Let us show you what we
are capable of.

[ Watch the Video ][116]

### Clever Devices is proud to serve top agencies in North America

From the largest public transport agency in the United States with over 6000 vehicles to a small
city agency with just 30 – Clever Devices’ customers come in all sizes. From Bus to Rail to
Paratransit, our cutting-edge solutions are designed for all modes of transportation.

### THE EXPERIENCE IS EVERYTHING!

#### In a world where riders have other options, real-time information is more important than ever
#### before

Every technology you consider should have your rider’s experience in mind. How you communicate with
your riders can be the difference between a satisfied customer and one who spreads their discontent
on social media.

[ Learn More ][117]

Managing ITS servers on-premises, whether in your own facility or through an external provider, can
be a significant drain on time, budget, and personnel. CleverCloud® is a hosted solution designed to
relieve that burden on transit agencies.

## Frequently asked questions

How can IndiaFilings help my business with GST registration and compliance?

IndiaFilings provides comprehensive GST registration services, ensuring your business complies with
GST laws. From registration to timely return filing and tax planning, we handle it all so you can

What is AI-powered automation, and how can it benefit my business?

AI-powered automation reduces manual workload by automating routine tasks like payroll processing,
GST filing, and employee attendance tracking. It boosts efficiency, minimises errors, and ensures
compliance with all regulatory requirements.

How do I automate my business compliance processes with IndiaFilings?

IndiaFilings integrates AI-powered solutions to automate processes such as GST filing, payroll, and
attendance tracking — ensuring compliance, saving time, and improving accuracy in your business
operations.

How does LEDGERS support compliance, registration, and taxation for companies?

LEDGERS provides a unified software platform covering regulatory compliance (MCA filings), GST and
income tax reporting, trademark registrations, and startup formations — enabling businesses to stay
compliant across jurisdictions.

What is the role of MCA compliance in India, and how do you assist?

Businesses in India must comply with Ministry of Corporate Affairs requirements — company/LLP
registration, annual filings, statutory returns and director KYC. LEDGERS handles these filings and
monitors due dates automatically.

## IPSES Srl

IPSES offre soluzioni di eccellenza in ambito industriale manifatturiero, aerospace & defence,
automotive & transport ed energy, rivolgendo la propria attenzione al settore del testing** e alla
progettazione di soluzioni elettroniche personalizzate**. Le applicazioni si rivolgono
principalmente al testing funzionale, di visione, RF e Boundary scan con piattaforme modulari
hardware e software, allo sviluppo hardware e software *embedded*, all’integrazione di sistemi, ad
applicazioni in ambiti RF e Timing and frequency generation. Gli standard elevati nella gestione di
progetti, anche complessi e multilevel, sono garantiti, oltre che dall'elevata competenza tecnica,
in termini di qualità e tracciabilità dei processi.

Design e  sviluppo di sistemi di test per *industrial electronics*, *automotive *e* aerospace
*mediante piattaforme modulari hardware e software.
Test funzionali, RF, Visione, Boundary Scan, Fixture & Support Tools, sia *off-line*, sia *in-line,*
facilmente espandibili e upgradabili.

**IPSES** è ***distributore ***italiano e ***technology partner*** di soluzioni e prodotti **XJTAG**
per il test boundary scan secondo lo standard **IEEE-1149.x**

Con ottime conoscenze delle piattaforme National Instruments e dell'integrazione dell'hardware e del
software NI, IPSES, ***Gold Partner* **di** NI**, fornisce soluzioni e servizi che uniscono
flessibilità e modularità del design a qualità, affidabilità e tempi certi, anche per progetti ad
elevata complessità, competitivi sia tecnologicamente che economicamente

[RF & Timing]

Progettiamo sistemi elettronici dedicati in grado di rispondere alle specifiche richieste dal
cliente, realizzando prototipi e piccole serie, partendo da un'analisi strutturata dei requisiti per
determinare tecnologie e metodi e documentando tutti i processi fino alla produzione.

Le nostre partnership certificano le nostre competenze nello sviluppo di soluzioni tecnologiche
dinamiche e innovative.

**Support your wellness routine with IV nutrient therapy designed to help maintain hydration, energy

thoughtfully formulated blends are designed to complement an active lifestyle and support your
body’s natural processes—helping you feel refreshed, balanced, and ready for what’s next. **IV

your best.

### GAS-POWERED

Legendary performance. Proven reliability. Mercedes-Benz gas-powered vehicles offer long-distance
convenience, making them the choice for those who prioritize the traditional driving experience
backed by decades of automotive excellence.

[Explore Vehicles][83]

### In The Spotlight

### Discover Mercedes-Benz

  Introducing Mercedes-Benz High Power Charging to Canada – open to every EV.
  Learn More

### Maybach, the true measure of luxury

Going the greatest lengths to impress, Mercedes-Maybach is the ultimate in luxury driving. A rich
tradition of the finest materials crafted by expert hands, along with advanced technology for
unforgettable comfort, creates the highest order of elegance.

[Learn More][84]

### Mercedes-AMG: High-performance, dynamic driving.

Born on the track and bred for the road, each Mercedes-AMG vehicle was built for vicious speed and
rugged power. A boundless passion for motorsport and a legendary spirit for achievement, the World’s
Fastest Family is the ultimate in performance driving.

[Learn More][85]

[Explore The new 2027 Mercedes-Benz GLE][89]

## Frequently Asked Questions

## Q. How can I check my vehicle details in mParivahan?

You can check vehicle details using the mParivahan app by entering your vehicle registration number.
The app shows RC details, owner name, vehicle class, insurance validity, and more. It is an official
digital platform linked with the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.

## Q. How to find RC in Parivahan?

Visit the official Parivahan portal and enter your registration number under “Vehicle Related
Services.” You can view RC status, ownership details, registration date, and RTO information online.

## Q. Is the mParivahan virtual RC valid?

Yes, the virtual RC available in the mParivahan app is legally valid under the Information
Technology Act. It is accepted by traffic police across India as a digital alternative to the
physical RC.

## Q. What is Lok Adalat?

Lok Adalat means “People’s Court.” It is a government-backed forum in India that helps resolve legal
disputes quickly, peacefully, and without lengthy court procedures.

## Q. How to check if the RC is original or fake?

To verify whether an RC is original, check the registration number on the official Parivahan website
or Vehicleinfo. If the details match the physical RC (owner name, engine number, chassis number), it
is genuine. Always verify before buying a used vehicle.

## Q. What is an RC book?

An RC (Registration Certificate) book is an official document issued by the Regional Transport
Office (RTO). It contains the vehicle registration number, owner details, engine number, chassis
number, fuel type, and registration validity.

## Q. How can I check my RTO memo online?

You can check the RTO memo or pending issues by visiting the Parivahan or Vehicleinfo and entering
your vehicle number. The portal displays any blacklisted status, hypothecation details, or pending
actions.

## Q. How to check Delhi traffic challan online?

To check Delhi traffic challan status, visit the official Delhi Traffic Police website. Enter your
vehicle number or driving license number to view pending and paid challans.

## Q. How to check a paid challan in Telangana?

You can check the paid or pending challan status by visiting the Telangana State Police e-challan
portal. Enter your vehicle registration number or challan number to see payment status and violation
details.

## Q. How can I check my TS challan?

You can check your Telangana (TS) e-challan status through the Telangana State Police official
traffic challan website. Enter your vehicle registration number to view violation details, fine
amount, and payment status.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## Q. How can I check my vehicle details in mParivahan?

You can check vehicle details using the mParivahan app by entering your vehicle registration number.
The app shows RC details, owner name, vehicle class, insurance validity, and more. It is an official
digital platform linked with the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.

## Q. How to find RC in Parivahan?

Visit the official Parivahan portal and enter your registration number under “Vehicle Related
Services.” You can view RC status, ownership details, registration date, and RTO information online.

## Q. Is the mParivahan virtual RC valid?

Yes, the virtual RC available in the mParivahan app is legally valid under the Information
Technology Act. It is accepted by traffic police across India as a digital alternative to the
physical RC.

## Q. What is Lok Adalat?

Lok Adalat means “People’s Court.” It is a government-backed forum in India that helps resolve legal
disputes quickly, peacefully, and without lengthy court procedures.

## Q. How to check if the RC is original or fake?

To verify whether an RC is original, check the registration number on the official Parivahan website
or Vehicleinfo. If the details match the physical RC (owner name, engine number, chassis number), it
is genuine. Always verify before buying a used vehicle.

## Q. What is an RC book?

An RC (Registration Certificate) book is an official document issued by the Regional Transport
Office (RTO). It contains the vehicle registration number, owner details, engine number, chassis
number, fuel type, and registration validity.

## Q. How can I check my RTO memo online?

You can check the RTO memo or pending issues by visiting the Parivahan or Vehicleinfo and entering
your vehicle number. The portal displays any blacklisted status, hypothecation details, or pending
actions.

## Q. How to check Delhi traffic challan online?

To check Delhi traffic challan status, visit the official Delhi Traffic Police website. Enter your
vehicle number or driving license number to view pending and paid challans.

## Q. How to check a paid challan in Telangana?

You can check the paid or pending challan status by visiting the Telangana State Police e-challan
portal. Enter your vehicle registration number or challan number to see payment status and violation
details.

## Q. How can I check my TS challan?

You can check your Telangana (TS) e-challan status through the Telangana State Police official
traffic challan website. Enter your vehicle registration number to view violation details, fine
amount, and payment status.
